title: Street Levels in the Tyropoeon Valley. II
author: R. W. Hamilton
location_note: Tariq el Wad near Tariq Bab es Silsileh, under the viaduct arch east of the Khaldi Library, Old City of Jerusalem; no map reference; placed by name.
reading: pp. 34-35 in full; then eligible-class keyword paragraphs (pp. 36-40)
notes: Observations during the 1931 El Wad sewer works and an excavation inside a viaduct arch: cross-wall, Arab-period pier and arch, upper street of diagonal flags; lower (Herodian or later) street cut by the viaduct. Coins of the procurators (AD 10, 18) under the pavement with 7th-c. Arab coins; streets and walls not eligible.

features.site: El Wad, north of the cross-wall
features.subtype: old vaulted sewer under the street, narrowing and slab-roofed beyond the cross-wall
features.quote: its vaulted roof replaced by horizontal slabs

features.subtype: drainage opening in the pier with a channel running south-east under the paving
features.period: with the pier and arch, 'indubitably Arab work' (excavator)
features.quote: a channel runs diagon- ally south-east from the drainage open- ing
